paragraphs: Focus School Software sells systems that districts use to manage student data, finance data, human resources data and assessment administration. The line runs from a K12 student information system to a CTE and adult education system and an enterprise resource planning system.

Modules and features are reached from a single login, single interface and single database. The company says custom fields, forms, reports, alerts and workflow let a district shape the systems to its own practice. A unified portal keeps parents informed and involved in their children's progress. A hosting option is offered that the company says saves a district time and money.

Focus has centred its product development on the educational environment since 2006. It says it has assembled a team of 180 professionals who share a passion for education. The company states that its systems reach three-fourths of the districts in Florida and serve more than 3,700,000 students. Its chief executive, Andrew Schmadeke, worked in software development in the education technology industry before founding the company.
